final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT bp.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS avg_double FROM batting_postseason AS bp JOIN player AS p ON bp.player_id = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY WHERE p.bats <> '' COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_double) AS overall_avg FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.player_id, s1.bats, s1.avg_double, s1.avg_double / s2.overall_avg AS ratio FROM s1 CROSS JOIN s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT bats, AVG(ratio) AS bats_avg_ratio FROM s3 GROUP BY bats) SELECT s3.player_id, s3.bats, s3.avg_double, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.bats_avg_ratio FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s3.bats = s4.bats COLLATE BINARY ORDER BY s3.ratio - s4.bats_avg_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
